text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...My skin's feeling kinda dry, damn it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I can't settle down. At this rate, 
I'll be totally distracted during the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haa, guess I got no choice. I hate 
owing favors, but maybe I'll ask someone 
who knows about this stuff...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seemed restless and 
distracted, unable to stop worrying about 
her rough skin...
